title: 11 Best Herbal Tinctures For Bloating
intro: Herbal tinctures for bloating are concentrated liquid extracts made from herbs and plants that have been traditionally used to alleviate digestive discomfort and bloating. Additionally, tinctures made from herbs like chamomile, lavender, and passionflower can also help soothe the digestive system and reduce stress, which is often a contributing factor to bloating.
